description.value: Telecom Egypt (المصرية للاتصالات) is a long-standing telecommunications company with over 170 years of history, providing a comprehensive range of services. It caters to both personal and business customers, offering mobile, internet, and landline services, alongside advanced solutions such as data and connectivity, cloud computing, digital solutions, fleet tracking, and hosted call centers, operating across local, regional, and global levels.
